finalText:
Roughly **950 spots are safe to rename, 210 are not**.

94 files hold `account_id`. Five zones must keep it.

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | public contract, frozen |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) | 1 | right side is the wire key |
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk`](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/schema.js) | 20 | generated, `vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| [`migrations/*.sql`](migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql) | 61 | applied history, breaks down step |
| SQL strings in 25 repo files | 125 | real DB column name |

Safe part is plain JS identifiers in `services/` and `lib/audit.js`.

Next: make them split the DB column rename into its own migration.
